v3_search_rules.open_window_terms_role: OR supplement inside the I block or citation-chasing source only; never an AND term, filter or eligibility criterion. If an OR supplement line is used, log it as a separate search-history line within the EI entry and record its marginal yield during seed testing.
v3_search_rules.open_window_phrase_evidence: 18 PubMed title/abstract records 2018-2026 combine "open window"/"open-window" with exercise and immune terms (02_preliminary/collision_recheck_2026-10-04.md §6 query a; reconnaissance, not a protocol search).
v3_search_rules.organising_window: 0-72 h after cessation of an identifiable bout, applied at screening/charting; not a search limit or inclusion cap. Samples > 72 h are extracted and tagged outside-window recovery; no new exclusion code.
v3_search_rules.population_rule_applied_at_screening: Adults >= 18 y; mixed-age cohorts only with a separable adult stratum; < 18 y excluded under FT03; older adults included and flagged as a subgroup.
v3_search_rules.exposure_rule: No intensity, duration or mode threshold; these are recorded at extraction and used as evidence-map strata.
v3_search_rules.support_B: Retained (cross-bout open-window monitoring layer); applied at screening.
v3_search_rules.T_block_role: REQUIRED concept in every route on every platform and in the preprint F1/F2 strings from strategy v0.7 (PRE-003; search_strategy_draft.txt §1 and §8). T is a concept block, not a timing limit; the 0-72 h organising window stays a screening/charting rule. The T-free union E AND (I OR O) is kept only as a pilot sensitivity check on a random sample of E AND (I OR O) NOT T records.
v3_search_rules.pilot_timing: 50-record screening pilot runs after the v3.0 archive release (GitHub Release + Zenodo version DOI) on a preserved draft search pool; formal five-database search starts only after the archived release exists.

missed_seed_diagnosis.NEG-E2: Animal endurance-training study; no T wording. Expected FT02 exclusion.
missed_seed_diagnosis.CIT-R3: Review with no T wording; named citation-chasing source, enters by citation chasing.
missed_seed_diagnosis.CIT-R4: Review with no T wording; named citation-chasing source.
missed_seed_diagnosis.CIT-R5: Review with no T wording; named citation-chasing source.
missed_seed_diagnosis.rescue_test: None of the five is retrieved even when kinetics, "days after", "24 h", "48 h" and "72 h" are added (step: excluded-term marginal runs). Diagnosis consistent with Addendum 2 §A2.4.

seed_detection.post_hoc_note: the repairs that recover POS-C1 were designed after its Addendum-2 miss; 10/10 is not an independent recall test

noise_samples.method: 20 PMIDs drawn with random.seed(20261004) from the (up to 5,000 most recent) records that the term retrieves within V1 and no other candidate T term retrieves (candidate set at 13:58Z included the excluded terms); titles read by one AI reader for D; rough indicator only, not screening

pubmed_2026_10_04_v07_addendum3.workload_assumptions: Title/abstract screening at 1 min per record per reviewer, two reviewers: person-hours = records x 2 / 60; five-database raw volume assumed 1.5-2.5x PubMed before deduplication (assumption, as Addendum 2).
pubmed_2026_10_04_v07_addendum3.not_verified: WoS, Scopus, Embase.com/Ovid and SPORTDiscus T translations not live-parser checked (proximity semantics, stop words in phrases, hyphens, thesaurus T headings: strategy §8 login checks). Recall of T for numeric-only timing reports is untested (no such seed).

pilot_pool_runs.description: PubMed-only DRAFT POOL from strategy v0.7 for the post-release 50-record title/abstract screening pilot. Not a formal search: the formal-run fields in `searches` stay null.

citation_chasing_round1_2026_10_05.description: Supplemental search round 1: backward+forward citation chasing of the five open-window reviews named as citation-chasing sources in protocol v3.0 section E / Amendment PRE-003 (Peake 2017, Campbell & Turner 2018, Simpson 2020, Shi 2025, Xie 2026). NOT a formal search: produces no PRISMA counts and populates none of the formal-run fields in `searches`, which stay null. The second citation-chasing round (over INCLUDED studies, post-screening) is separate and not yet run. Full detail: 03_search/citation_chasing_round1_2026-10-05/summary.json and README.md.

entries.description: Supplemental citation-chasing round 1 (backward+forward) on a single protocol-section-E review. Not a formal search: the formal-run fields in `searches` stay null. Eligibility NOT assessed; titles only, no abstracts stored.
entries.backward_query: PubMed efetch <ReferenceList> (db=pubmed, retmode=xml); Crossref works/<doi> reference array fallback for Peake 2017; OpenAlex works/pmid:<id> referenced_works fallback for Simpson 2020 (0 returned)
entries.forward_query: PubMed elink.fcgi dbfrom=pubmed linkname=pubmed_pubmed_citedin (batched call, 5 source PMIDs); OpenAlex works?filter=cites:<openalex_id> (cursor-paginated); OpenCitations api.opencitations.net/index/v2/citations/<doi> attempted, FAILED for all 5 DOIs (see summary.json)
